title.narrative: Year 2 Payment CSF 11-21 for the project Peace Building from the Ground Up

description.narrative: The ‘Peacebuilding from the ground up in Yemen’ project aims to support civil society organisations and communities in Yemen, with a focus on marginalised groups, such as women and youth, to work together with local authorities to address the root causes of conflict and insecurity and enable them to contribute to longer-term peace and security. The implementing partners are Youth without Borders Organization for Development, National Organization for Community Development Society, and Alf Ba Civilisation and Coexistence Foundation. The objective is to reduce humanitarian need by ensuring conflict-affected communities in Yemen are more stable and resilient to shocks, through contributing to a more inclusive and sustainable political settlement. The key activities include enabling communities to work together with authorities in identifying and addressing the key drivers of conflict in their communities; enabling Yemeni CSOs to influence national and international level peace processes through the delivery of joint advocacy and peacebuilding interventions based on community priorities; enabling Yemeni women activists and women’s rights organisations to influence peace processes at all levels through the delivery of joint peacebuilding interventions; and enabling international stakeholders, including diplomats, policy-makers, and INGOs to develop solutions and policy ideas for a more inclusive long-term peace process and to take decisions on key Yemen policies and strategies informed by peace and security priorities identified by communities and CSOs including women.
